items.title: Munters CMD 2026: Expanding position in precision climate control
items.summary: Munters CMD 2026: Expanding position in precision climate control 2026-11-11 18:00:00 Stockholm, Sweden, Nov 11, 2026 - Munters Group today at a Capital Markets Day presented its strategic direction for the coming years: To build on its leadership in precision climate control and expand its position across selected parts of the applied HVAC market, by leveraging its strong portfolio of solutions for humidity, thermal and air quality control. items.title: Munters Group AB: Munters announces investments to strengthen data center supply chain and capacity
items.summary: Munters Group AB: Munters announces investments to strengthen data center supply chain and capacity 2026-11-11 12:00:00 Munters Group today announced it has entered into an agreement with Lordan, a producer of high-quality fin and tube heat exchangers, to establish a joint venture for coil manufacturing in the US. The company also said it plans to expand its facility for chiller production in Italy. US joint venture Munters will invest MUSD 9.5 (approximately MSEK 90) and hold 45% in the joint venture company, with Lordan holding the remaining 55%. items.title: Munters Group AB: Munters uppdaterar sina finansiella mål
items.summary: Munters Group AB: Munters uppdaterar sina finansiella mål 2026-11-11 08:30:00 Stockholm, 11 november 2026 - Munters Group, en global ledare inom teknologier som optimerar klimat, presenterar i dag vid en kapitalmarknadsdag uppdaterade finansiella mål, inklusive ett modifierat marginalmål och ett nytt mål för avkastning på sysselsatt kapital (ROCE). Munters behåller samtidigt sitt mål för genomsnittlig årlig tillväxt. items.title: Munters Group AB: Significant order growth as operational improvements progress
items.summary: Munters Group AB: Significant order growth as operational improvements progress 2026-10-23 07:30:00 July - September Order intake increased +70%, driven by strong demand in Data Center Technologies (DCT) and AirTech. Net sales increased +18%, driven by all business areas, particularly AirTech. In AirTech growth was driven primarily by Americas and APAC. DCT grew through continued backlog execution and higher production volumes, while FoodTech recorded slight growth. The adjusted EBITA margin declined.
